bus_capacitance.note: 4x560uF bulk in parallel + 470nF film, all from PFC_BUS_PLUS_390V to PFC_BUS_MINUS (netlist).

bus_discharge_natural.note: passive bleed path hv_plus->bleeder1->bleeder2->control_gnd. No active bus-discharge part is present on this candidate netlist.

claim_586_7.proof_it_is_a_sum: AR-VERIFY raw/compute_ar_verify.py:415 computes round(v_bus + v_peak_132, 2); margin line 422 computes 600/(v_bus+v_peak_132).
claim_586_7.verdict: NOT A SINGLE-FAULT DEVICE STRESS (see result.json).

boost_switch_short.loop: mains L -> F1 -> CMC L1-L2 -> NTC(U4, bypassed by U5 when running) -> bridge U1 AC1 -> upper diode -> PLUS -> L(U8) -> a1 -> shorted U9 -> PFC_BUS_MINUS(control_gnd) -> shunt U12 -> bridge MINUS -> lower diode -> AC2 -> CMC N2-N1 -> mains N
boost_switch_short.bus_cap_reason: D10 (a1->hv_plus) is reverse-biased by the full bus voltage; there is no path from hv_plus to the shorted switch.

pre_saturation.note: L limits di/dt only until Isat(43 A typ, 30% drop).

bridge_sees.note: bridge output tracks the rectified line (inductor averages ~0 V).

boost_diode_short.fault_node_map: d_boost.K(2)=hv_plus shorted to d_boost.A1/A2(1,3)=a1; a1 DC-couples through L to bridge PLUS

standing_voltage.why_not_586_7: the bridge's own low-side diode clamps each AC terminal to >= MINUS-Vf, so the line cannot pull an AC node to the opposite peak; max reverse across a bridge diode is ~V_BUS.

if_switch_conducts.label: bus-cap discharge (internal loop; AC fuse F1 does NOT see it)
if_switch_conducts.caveat: requires the controller to keep U9 on after D10 shorts; if the 400 V bus is fed back on VSENSE the controller has no signal to stop, but its response is not established here.

fuse_F1.pre_arcing_i2t_note: NOT captured anywhere in this tree; no I2t/time-current coordination analysis exists (BOM.md:77).

line_vs_cap_timescale.line_frequency_fault: rectified 120 Hz current fed through F1; interrupted by the 16 A time-lag fuse (timescale ms..10s of ms, not established).
line_vs_cap_timescale.cap_discharge: 2240 uF through ~50 mohm: tau ~= 116 us; the AC fuse is not in this loop, so nothing on the board interrupts it.

mov_in_loop.connection: l1 (line after F1) to AC_N_RECTIFIED_INPUT (neutral) - line-to-neutral, downstream of the fuse
mov_in_loop.reason: neither bus rail reaches the MOV's terminals; it clamps the line only. It is therefore NOT automatically (and here, not at all) in either internal fault loop.
